en: Local visual effect only. Refracts a scene-background copy through the original character, cape and held weapon geometry. Keeps their original animation; does not change enemy detection. Experimental: unsupported materials stay visible.
zh: 仅本机视觉效果。用人物、披风和手持武器的原模型折射场景背景副本，保留原有动画，不改变敌人识别。实验功能：尚未支持的材质保持正常显示。

en: Shows the number of enemies targeting you and the red warning ring at your feet. Enemy reinforcement alerts are independent.
zh: 显示正在以你为目标的敌人数量，以及脚下红色警示圈。关闭不影响敌方增援提示。

en: The hologram's colours. Full colour: throwables, stims and ammo each in their own colour. Royal blue: everything in royal blue, including the health bar; warnings and limb damage stay red. Ice blue: as royal blue, with lit parts in pale ice blue, dim parts in a deeper blue and warnings in orange-red; limb damage stays red. Changing this rebuilds the hologram.
zh: 全息界面的配色。彩色：投掷物、医疗针和弹药使用各自颜色的图标。宝蓝：全部使用宝蓝色，包括生命值条；警告和肢体受伤仍为红色。冰蓝：与宝蓝相同，但亮部为浅冰蓝、暗部为深蓝，警告为橘红色；肢体受伤仍为红色。更改后全息界面将重新生成。

en: How brightly the hologram glows, from 1 (dimmest) to 6 (brightest); each step is about 1.5 times the one below. It brightens automatically in daylight. Changing this rebuilds the hologram.
zh: 全息界面的发光强度，1 最暗、6 最亮，每档约为下一档的 1.5 倍。日光下会自动提亮。更改后全息界面将重新生成。

en: When on, the hologram flickers now and then and floats slightly. When off, it stays still.
zh: 开启后，全息界面会偶尔闪烁并轻微浮动；关闭后保持静止。

en: The hologram's occasional flicker and sideways glitch. When off, there is no flicker; floating and scanlines are unaffected.
zh: 全息界面偶尔的闪烁和横向错位。关闭后不再闪烁，浮动和扫描线不受影响。

en: Horizontal scanlines across the hologram. When off, digits and icons are drawn solid. Changing this rebuilds the hologram.
zh: 全息界面上的水平扫描线。关闭后数字和图标显示为完整图形。更改后全息界面将重新生成。

en: When off, the ammo count shows only while R is held.
zh: 关闭时，仅在按住 R 键时显示弹药数。

en: Applies when the ammo count is always shown. When on, spare ammo shows as well; when off, only the rounds in the magazine show, and the slash and spare ammo appear while R is held.
zh: 在弹药数始终显示时生效。开启后同时显示备弹；关闭后仅显示弹匣内弹药，按住 R 键时才显示斜线和备弹。

en: Shows the ammo left in your backpack as blue dots below the stims.
zh: 在医疗针下方以蓝点显示背包中剩余的弹药。

en: For weapons that switch ammo types (such as airburst and high explosive), shows the current mode beside the ammo count: off; dots (one or two); or the game's own icon to the right of the count.
zh: 对于可切换弹药的武器（如空爆、高爆），在弹药数旁显示当前弹药模式：关闭；圆点（一个或两个）；或游戏原版图标，显示在弹药数右侧。

en: Shows the game's semi-auto, burst and full-auto icons beside the ammo count. Other fire modes show nothing.
zh: 在弹药数旁显示半自动、连射和全自动图标（游戏原版样式）。其他射击模式不显示。

en: For weapons with an adjustable rate of fire, shows the current setting as one to three chevrons to the right of the ammo-mode dots.
zh: 对于可调射速的武器，在弹药模式圆点右侧以一至三个箭头显示当前射速档位。

en: When a stowed weapon is not loaded, a warning appears where it hangs: a red X or a red weapon icon.
zh: 武器未装填时，在其挂载位置显示警告：红叉，或红色武器图标。

en: Shows a reticle where you aim: on foot, only while aiming; always as a vehicle gunner, in a mech or on an emplacement; as a passenger, while leaning out.
zh: 在瞄准位置显示准星：步行时仅在瞄准时显示；担任载具炮手、驾驶机甲或使用固定武器时始终显示；作为乘客探身时显示。

en: Dot; EOTech (a ticked ring, a centre dot and a second dot below it); ring and dot; small cross; or cross and dot.
zh: 可选：圆点；EOTech（带刻度的圆环、中心点及其下方一点）；圆环加中心点；小十字；十字加中心点。

en: The reticle's own brightness, independent of the glow setting; 1 is dimmest, 6 brightest. Raise it in strong light.
zh: 准星自身的亮度，不受辉光设置影响；1 最暗、6 最亮，强光下可调高。

en: Also shows the reticle at the game's aim point when holding a sidearm without aiming, such as when firing on the move.
zh: 手持副武器且未瞄准时（如跑动射击），也在游戏瞄准点显示准星。

en: Where the reticle sits while aiming. Game aim point: matches where shots actually land and is the most accurate, but does not follow the weapon's motion. Barrel: follows the muzzle and sways with the weapon for a more natural look, but drifts when crouching or prone. Both follow the barrel while reloading or cycling the bolt.
zh: 瞄准时准星的位置。游戏瞄准点：与实际弹着点一致，最为准确，但不随枪械动作移动。枪管：跟随枪口指向和枪械晃动，观感更真实，但蹲下或卧倒时会有偏差。装填和拉栓时两者均跟随枪管。

en: Two bars to the right of the ammo count: health (green, in four segments) and stamina beneath it.
zh: 在弹药数右侧显示两条状态条：生命值（绿色，分四段）及其下方的耐力。

en: Size of the health and stamina bars, from 1 (smallest) to 10 (largest); the default is 5.
zh: 生命值与耐力条的大小，1 最小、10 最大，默认为 5。

en: An injured torso, arm or leg is covered by a net of small flickering red crosses, with the body visible through it, until a stim heals it.
zh: 受伤的躯干、手臂或腿部会被一层闪烁的红色小叉覆盖，可透过其看到身体；使用医疗针治愈后消失。

en: Shows stratagems to the lower left of your character only at cooldown alerts: briefly every 30 seconds, a countdown for the last 10 seconds and a flash when ready. All are shown while the stratagem menu is open.
zh: 在人物左下方显示战备，仅在冷却提示时出现：每 30 秒短暂提示一次，最后 10 秒显示倒计时，就绪时闪烁一次；打开战备菜单时全部显示。

en: A holographic list to the lower left of your character: each stratagem's icon, its code (arrows grouped, entered arrows lit) and its cooldown. Everything shows while the game's stratagem menu is open; otherwise a row appears only at its cooldown alerts. Icons only: just the icons. Icons and cooldowns: no codes.
zh: 在人物左下方以全息列表显示战备：图标、指令（箭头分组显示，已输入的箭头会点亮）及冷却时间。打开游戏的战备菜单时显示全部，其余时间仅在冷却提示时显示对应的一行。仅图标：只显示图标。图标和冷却：不显示指令。

en: With the stratagem menu closed, shows the Reinforce icon and the reinforcements remaining at its lower left. 10 s after a change: shown for 10 seconds after the count changes. Always: shown at all times.
zh: 战备菜单关闭时，在其左下方显示增援图标及剩余增援次数。变化后显示 10 秒：次数改变后显示 10 秒。始终显示：持续显示。

en: With the stratagem menu closed, your four stratagems always show to the lower left of your character, with countdowns while cooling down. When off, they appear only at cooldown alerts.
zh: 战备菜单关闭时，在人物左下方始终显示你携带的四个战备，冷却中显示倒计时。关闭后仅在冷却提示时显示。

en: With the stratagem menu closed, the team Resupply always shows in the cooldown panel, with a countdown while cooling down.
zh: 战备菜单关闭时，在冷却栏中始终显示团队补给，冷却中显示倒计时。

en: Shows where orbital strikes, Eagle strikes and Hellbombs will hit, using the game's own data. When off, none of the items below are shown.
zh: 根据游戏数据显示轨道打击、飞鹰打击及地狱火炸弹的波及范围。关闭后以下各项均不显示。

en: The whole area of a strike, including a Hellbomb's: hidden, warning tape only, or a sphere with warning tape.
zh: 一次打击（含地狱火炸弹）的整体范围：不显示、仅显示警戒带，或显示球体及警戒带。

en: Where each orbital shell lands: hidden, a ring of warning tape, or a small sphere.
zh: 每发轨道炮弹的落点：不显示、一圈警戒带，或一个小球体。

en: Where each Eagle bomb, rocket or round lands: hidden, or a small sphere.
zh: 飞鹰每枚炸弹、火箭或炮弹的落点：不显示，或一个小球体。

en: Height of the lower edge of the upright warning tapes at Eagle and shell impacts, in metres. Please report the value you settle on to the author.
zh: 竖直警戒带高度（开发用）
飞鹰和炮弹落点处竖直警戒带的底边离地高度，单位：米。请将确定的数值反馈给作者。

en: Opacity and brightness of all warning tapes (the large sphere's, the Eagles' and the shells'), in percent; the sphere itself is unchanged. Please report the value you settle on to the author.
zh: 警戒带不透明度（开发用）
所有警戒带（大球体、飞鹰及炮弹落点）的不透明度与亮度，单位：百分比；球体本身不变。请将确定的数值反馈给作者。

en: With Reticle position set to Game aim point: how many frames the reticle trails the camera when you swing, to match the game's circle. Please report the value you settle on to the author.
zh: 准星位置为“游戏瞄准点”时，甩枪时准星比镜头晚几帧跟上，用来对齐游戏的圆圈。请将确定的数值反馈给作者。

en: A card above each teammate's head: the game's own tag (a letter and number) in a frame of their squad colour, never hidden by obstacles.
zh: 在每位队友头顶上方显示名片：游戏自带的标识（字母和编号），外框为该队友的小队颜色，不会被遮挡。

en: Each teammate's booster, in their colour, to the left of their card.
zh: 在队友名片左侧以该队友的颜色显示其携带的强化。

en: Each teammate's name, in their colour, above their card.
zh: 在队友名片上方以该队友的颜色显示其名字。

choices: Only the one you look at
en: Each teammate's distance in metres, to the right of their card. Only the one you look at: just the teammate whose card is nearest the centre of the screen.
zh: 在队友名片右侧显示与你的距离（米）。仅注视的队友：只显示名片最靠近屏幕中央的那位队友。

en: When a teammate has one stim left, a stim icon blinks below their card. A teammate out of stims while the game's own warning is red: their card flashes red, regardless of this setting.
zh: 队友只剩一根医疗针时，在其名片下方显示医疗针图标并闪烁。队友医疗针用完且游戏自身的警告变红时，名片以红色闪烁，不受此设置影响。

en: When you look at a fallen teammate's skull, their distance from you in metres shows to its right.
zh: 注视阵亡队友的骷髅时，在骷髅右侧显示与你的距离（米）。

en: Only for the teammate you look at (the card nearest the centre of the screen): their backpack and four stratagems between their name and card, with a bar under each stratagem on cooldown that shrinks as it becomes ready. The option sets when it shows: with the map open, or always.
zh: 仅针对你注视的队友（名片最靠近屏幕中央者）：在其名字与名片之间显示其背包及四个战备，冷却中的战备下方有一条随就绪逐渐缩短的条。选项决定显示时机：打开地图时，或始终显示。

en: While seated in a vehicle, the surrounding ground is scanned every few seconds and marked by slope: blue for flat, yellow for sloping and a red X for steep. Rocks and buildings are not marked.
zh: 乘坐载具时，每隔数秒扫描周围地面并按坡度标示：蓝色为平坦，黄色为倾斜，红叉为坡度很大。岩石和建筑不予标示。

en: Shows waypoints placed on the map in the world as a haze of rising motes in the waypoint's colour, hidden behind terrain. For a few seconds after placing one, and while the map is open, a straight line runs along the ground from you to it.
zh: 在世界中显示地图上放置的路标：一团以路标颜色缓缓上升的光点，被地形遮挡时不可见。放置路标后的数秒内及打开地图时，地面上会显示一条从你通往路标的直线。

en: Night vision is toggled with the Toggle night vision key (Keys page): the whole image is amplified, with grain and outlines of nearby objects; the hologram and the game's own HUD are unaffected. Choose teal, the grey-white of newer white-phosphor tubes, or false colour: brightness shown as colour, from dark blue through violet and red to yellow-white, the way a thermal camera's palette looks (it shows light, not heat).
zh: 夜视通过按键页的“夜视开关”键开启或关闭：整个画面增强提亮，带有颗粒和近处轮廓线；全息界面和游戏原生界面保持不变。颜色可选青绿、新型白磷夜视仪的灰白色，或伪彩色：按亮度上色，从深蓝、紫、红到黄白，看起来像热成像的配色（显示的是亮度，不是温度）。

en: The sound played as the map scan starts (the first ring each time the map opens): off, one of three, or one at random. A temporary setting for choosing a sound.
zh: 开始地图扫描时（每次打开地图的第一圈）播放的音效：关闭、三种之一，或随机。此为临时设置，用于选定音效。

choices: Mission info, compass, map and chat only
仅保留任务信息、罗盘、地图和聊天
en: Which parts of the game's own HUD remain. Mission info, compass, map and chat only: the rest (stratagems, your panel, squad, stamina, crosshair, drop wheel and so on) is hidden and left to the hologram. By the game's settings: hide what you can in the game's own settings; only what they cannot hide is hidden here (the squad bar, the kill count, the map's key hints, the hold-R menu's arrows and the drop wheel; the limb injury and cannot-climb icons to follow), which costs less. Everything: nothing is hidden.
zh: 游戏自带界面保留哪些部分。仅保留任务信息、罗盘、地图和聊天：其余部分（战备、个人面板、队友、耐力条、准星、丢弃菜单等）隐藏，由全息界面替代。按游戏设置：能在游戏设置中关闭的请自行关闭，这里只隐藏游戏设置关不掉的部分（队友栏、击杀计数、地图右下角按键提示、长按 R 菜单的箭头和丢弃菜单；肢体受伤和无法攀爬图标随后加入），开销更低。全部显示：不隐藏任何部分。

en: Shows the metering values at the top left of the screen: the game's exposure, scene brightness, hologram compensation, and sky and sun light. If the hologram looks too bright or too dark, send a screenshot to the author to help tune the automatic brightness.
zh: 在屏幕左上角显示测光数值：游戏感光、画面亮度、全息补偿、天光与阳光。若全息界面过亮或过暗，请截图发送给作者，用于调整自动亮度。

en: After you ping the ground, an object or a nest (Q), a small 3D model of the surrounding area appears beside you, turns once and fades. The Ping sandbox key (Keys page) shows the most recent one again. When off, none is made.
zh: 使用 Q 键标记地面、物体或巢穴后，在你身旁显示标记点周围的小型立体沙盘，旋转一周后消失。按键页的“标记沙盘”键可再次显示最近一个。关闭后不生成。

en: The radius the ping sandbox covers, from 20 to 100 m. The smaller it is, the finer the ground and the smaller the objects shown.
zh: 标记沙盘覆盖的半径，20 至 100 米。范围越小，地面越精细，可显示的物体也越小。

en: The sandbox's sideways offset from you, positive to the right, in metres. Please report the value you settle on to the author; this setting will be removed later.
zh: 沙盘相对人物的左右偏移，正值向右，单位：米。请将确定的数值反馈给作者，此项日后将移除。

en: The sandbox's forward offset from you, positive ahead, in metres. Please report the value you settle on to the author; this setting will be removed later.
zh: 沙盘相对人物的前后偏移，正值向前，单位：米。请将确定的数值反馈给作者，此项日后将移除。

en: While the map is open the scan runs continuously, and ground markers, teammate distances and the Super Beacon update as usual. This sets only how many scan rings are drawn: the first, the first two, or all of them.
zh: 打开地图时扫描持续进行，地面标记、队友距离和超级信标照常更新。此项仅设置扫描圈的显示次数：仅第一圈、前两圈，或打开地图时始终显示。

en: When the map scan passes them, teammates are shown for 10 seconds: outlined when in view, as blinking blue squares behind walls.
zh: 地图扫描经过时显示队友：可见时显示轮廓，被遮挡时显示闪烁的蓝色方块，持续 10 秒。

en: When the map scan passes them, Super Earth troops are shown for 10 seconds: outlined when in view, as blinking blue squares behind walls.
zh: 扫描显示超级地球部队
地图扫描经过时显示超级地球部队：可见时显示轮廓，被遮挡时显示闪烁的蓝色方块，持续 10 秒。

en: When the map scan passes them, groups of live enemies show as loose clouds of blinking red squares, visible through walls, for 10 seconds; positions are approximate.
zh: 地图扫描经过时，存活的敌人按群显示为一团闪烁的红色方块（可透墙看到），持续 10 秒，仅提供大致方位。

en: Blue domes ripple out from the tip of each radar station within 500 m, burst after burst. While scanning: from opening the map until 10 s after it is closed. Always: all the time.
zh: 500 米内的雷达站从塔尖向外荡出一阵阵蓝色半球波纹。扫描时：从打开地图起，到关掉地图后 10 秒；常亮：一直显示。

en: Small gold domes ripple about 25 m out from objectives you carry away (intel, launch codes, black boxes, SSSDs and the like) still lying where they were, within 60 m. While scanning: while the map scan runs. Always: all the time, round you. Once picked up, none.
zh: 还放在原地的可拾取目标（情报包、发射码、黑匣子、SSSD 等）向外荡出约 25 米的金色小半球波纹，60 米内。扫描时：地图扫描时显示；常亮：一直在你周围显示。被拿走后不再显示。

en: While the map scan runs, shock waves spread from each SEAF artillery within 200 m, bending the view as they pass.
zh: 地图扫描时，200 米内的 SEAF 火炮向外扩散冲击波，经过之处画面会被扭曲。

en: While the map scan runs, a shimmer of heat haze rises over each valve not yet turned (pump valves, hydrogen pipeline, organic plasma) within 150 m.
zh: 地图扫描时，150 米内还没拧的阀门（泵阀、氢气管道、有机等离子）上方升起一团晃动的热浪。

en: Within 20 m, weapons and backpacks lying on the ground show their remaining ammo 1 m above them: a thin ring with the numbers inside. The icon beside it follows the Dropped item label setting.
zh: 20 米内，地上的武器和背包上方 1 米处显示剩余弹药：一个细圆环及其中的数字。旁边的图标由“地面物品标识”设置控制。

en: Primary weapons on the ground (such as a fallen teammate's) are shown too. When off, only support weapons and backpacks are shown. Sidearms cannot be picked up and are never shown.
zh: 地上的主武器（如阵亡队友掉落的）也显示弹药和标识。关闭后仅显示支援武器和背包。副武器无法拾取，不予显示。

en: What the ring shows: the percentage remaining; rounds in the magazine and spare magazines (heat sinks for laser weapons); or the percentage from afar and the rounds within 5 m.
zh: 地上武器圆环内显示的内容：剩余百分比；弹匣内弹数 / 备用弹匣数（激光武器为散热器数）；或远处显示百分比、5 米内显示弹数。

en: Shows a dropped item's stratagem icon beside its ammo ring, or on its own for items without ammo (primary weapons have none). The icon over a deployed Solo Silo follows this setting too.
zh: 在地上物品的弹药圆环旁（无弹药的物品则单独）显示其战备图标（主武器没有）；关闭则不显示。已部署的单兵导弹发射井上方的图标也受此设置控制。

en: Distance of the hologram from your back, in centimetres.
zh: 全息界面与背部的距离，单位：厘米。

en: How far to shift the back panel to the right, in centimetres (negative: left). With a backpack or a support weapon on your back, measured from its right side.
zh: 背部面板向右偏移的距离，单位：厘米，负值向左。背负背包或支援武器时从其右侧算起。

en: How far to shift the stratagem menu to the right, in centimetres (negative: left). The stratagem rows shown while it is closed move with it.
zh: 战备菜单向右偏移的距离，单位：厘米，负值向左。菜单收起时显示的战备行也一起移动。

en: How high the mission info panel hangs, in degrees above the horizon.
zh: 任务信息面板在地平线以上的角度，单位：度。

en: How far right of where you face the mission info panel hangs, in degrees (negative: left).
zh: 任务信息面板偏离你面朝方向的角度，单位：度，正值向右，负值向左。

en: How far to shift the drop menu to the right, in centimetres (negative: left).
zh: 丢弃菜单向右偏移的距离，单位：厘米，负值向左。

en: When not aiming, how much further right of your body the ammo count and the health and stamina bars sit, in centimetres. 0 is the default position.
zh: 未瞄准时，弹药数与生命值、耐力条额外向右移动的距离，单位：厘米。0 为默认位置。

en: Smooths out the sway from walking and shooting. At 0, the hologram follows your back rigidly.
zh: 减轻行走和射击时的晃动。0 为完全跟随背部晃动。

en: How far the hologram turns toward the camera when you stand side-on. At 0, it lies flat against your back.
zh: 侧身时全息界面转向镜头的程度。0 为完全贴合背部方向。

en: Where the throwable, stim and backpack rows appear: always on your back; under the stamina bar on the right only while aiming (for close cameras where your back is out of view); or always on the right.
zh: 投掷物、医疗针、背包位置
投掷物、医疗针、背包三行的显示位置：始终在背部；仅瞄准时移至右侧耐力条下方（适用于镜头很近、看不到背部的情况）；或始终在右侧。

en: Turns experimental optical camouflage on or off. Unbound by default; choose a keyboard key or mouse button here.
zh: 开启或关闭实验性光学迷彩。默认未绑定，可在此设置键盘按键或鼠标按键。

en: Turns night vision on or off.
Shows the most recent ping sandbox again.
zh: 再次显示最近一个标记沙盘。

en: Opens and closes the holographic drop menu. While left at its default (X, the game's own drop key), it works only when the game's drop wheel is hidden (The game's own HUD not set to Everything).
zh: 打开或关闭全息丢弃菜单。保持默认（X，即游戏自带的丢弃键）时，仅在游戏的丢弃轮盘被隐藏时生效（“游戏原生界面”未设为“全部显示”）。

en: While the game's stratagem menu is closed
